name: Complete Passkey MFA
summary: Completes a user-verified Passkey assertion for the durable identity bound to a password-issued MFA challenge, consumes that MFA challenge, and establishes the authenticated application session.

sourceState.expression: session-capability == anonymous and password-issued mfa-challenge == pending and provider passkey is allowed

guards.expression: the MFA challenge is valid for provider passkey and the completed WebAuthn assertion proves a credential registered to the challenge-bound UserId

sourceReferences.note: Password-bound Passkey MFA endpoints delegate challenge-bound proof to IPasskeyMfaAuthenticationService, then establish browser or token session only after the service returns a proven AppUser.
MFA challenge validation enforces provider and durable UserId binding; the challenge is consumed only after the user-bound WebAuthn proof succeeds.
